response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux, c.cnt AS spatial_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
